principles: Clarity: Zero ambiguity in data presentation
Aesthetics: Clean Tech (Light) vs. Energy Flow (Dark)

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
DO NOT center text in dashboards. Left align everything for scanability.
Use 'Inter' for all data tables and dense information.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings and KPIs.
Ensure all text labels are in TURKISH language.
Implement Dark/Light mode toggle in the sidebar or header.
Use 'Bento Grid' layout for the main dashboard view.
All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attributes.
For PDF generation, use a clean, table-based layout with the company logo at the top.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Solar Energy Sales SaaS. Focus on the 'Admin Dashboard' and 'Quote Creation' flows first. Use the provided image URLs for the login page and product demos. Ensure the 'Bento Grid' layout is implemented in the dashboard. The UI must be in Turkish.
